name: Codex & Claude Usage
description: Shows Codex (ChatGPT) and Claude Code plan usage in the top bar: 5-hour and weekly limits, reset times, plan and account. Reads the tokens stored by the codex and claude CLIs; no background service needed. This extension talks to openai.com and anthropic.com services and is not affiliated with, funded by or endorsed by OpenAI or Anthropic.
